purpose: Apple-to-apple audit of the llama 67.29 tok/s / 1.342x baseline vs hipEngine, per the CLAUDE.md evidence policy. llama was measured via llama-server --protocol natural --max-tokens 512; hipEngine suite uses cycles=10 in-process. Tests whether the gap is a protocol/length artifact.

llama_baseline.protocol: llama-server natural max-tokens 512 (HTTP overhead INCLUDED in llama tok/s)

findings: hipEngine AR scales well: 54.55 -> 53.54 over 4x longer context, still ABOVE llama AR 50.19. Faster-AR claim robust to length.
hipEngine MTP uplift STABLE ~1.086-1.114x across window length; the 10-cycle number does NOT understate it.
llama 67.29 measured via llama-server includes HTTP/server overhead -> llamas raw compute is if anything higher.
CONCLUSION: the 60.8 vs 67.3 gap is GENUINE, robust to generation length and conservative on llamas side. NOT a measurement artifact. The baseline comparison is validated as fair.
